why: A mirror on the right swaps left and right but keeps up and down. So the E turns into a backwards E with its arms pointing left, which is option 2. Options 1, 3 and 4 are the E turned (rotated), not mirrored.
trick: Mirror = flip only; if the figure is turned at an angle it is a rotation, not a mirror image.
